description:
AdsTurbo turns ChatGPT into an ad creative workstation. Connect your AdsTurbo account and ask ChatGPT to produce ad videos and product images directly in the conversation.

What it can do:
- Clone a competitor ad: analyze a reference video into a shot-by-shot storyboard and prompts, then generate a new video with the same structure.
- Generate video from text or images, including first/last-frame and multi-reference generation, plus extending or locally editing an existing video.
- Create digital-human spokesperson videos: pick a platform AI actor, clone a custom persona from a photo and voice sample, or lip-sync a portrait to an audio track (TTS included).
- Clean up finished videos: remove watermarks, logos and burnt-in subtitles, upscale to 2K/4K, and add or translate subtitles.
- Transform videos: swap the on-screen person, drive a static portrait with a reference video's motion, or translate a whole video into another language.
- Create and edit images for e-commerce: text-to-image, background removal, product and scene shots, campaign posters, and upscaling.

Generation runs as background tasks; ChatGPT returns a link to each finished video or image. All assets you provide must be publicly accessible URLs.

Requires an AdsTurbo account with a Pro plan or above. Generation consumes AdsTurbo credits according to your plan.

defaultPrompt: Show me AI actors that would suit a fitness supplement ad
Make a 15-second spokesperson video reading my ad script
Create a product photo of my item on a marble countertop
